stage: Phase 0 accepted for now with deferred audits; Phase 1 repository foundation remains open
runtime_engine: independent Rust; no C Git/libgit2/gitoxide engine or subprocess fallback

extensions.repo rename: GitHub repository name update with identity/visibility verification
extensions.repo checks: read-only CI results with failed-check annotations and step metadata
extensions.repo job-log: bounded Actions job logs; restricted HTTPS storage redirect without credential forwarding
extensions.repo api: bounded read-only repository JSON; optional anonymous access
extensions.repo download: bounded immutable source/release and Actions artifact downloads with SHA-256 receipts and restricted credential-free storage redirects

credentials.macos: native Security.framework Internet Password lookup; FERRAGIT_CREDENTIAL_ACCOUNT selects the stored account
credentials.all_platforms: FERRAGIT_TOKEN override; no Git credential helpers

verified_scope: v2 stage-0 index and Git tree ordering
identical root and single-parent commit IDs with controlled identity/time
Rust-generated smart-HTTP request and non-delta pack accepted by C Git receive-pack
strict Git fsck of receiving repositories
stale locks, corrupt objects/index, unknown extensions and concurrent object writers
SHA-1/SHA-256 PACK v2/v3 and v1/v2 index reads, including OFS/REF deltas and escaped 64-bit offsets
packed-ref fallback with loose precedence and peeled-tag record validation
cross-storage abbreviation lookup with ambiguity and duplicate-ID handling
continued commits and Rust-generated pushes from packed history
index/pack checksum, CRC, offset, delta-bound, cycle/depth and reconstructed-ID failure cases
single-ref create/update with expected-old-ID checks under lock and loose-over-packed precedence
branch/HEAD reflog bytes for supported commits and updates, logging policies and unchanged refs
symbolic chains, stale locks, competing writers and observable partial ref/reflog failure effects
single-ref deletion and zero-NEW/old-value semantics, canonical packed rewrites preserving peeled tags, log effects and competing delete/update writers
symbolic-ref reads, quiet non-symbolic/missing results, one-level/recursive chains and malformed/depth-bound cases
known_gaps: full pinned distribution/build-profile audit and full upstream shell suite
linked worktrees, advanced index flags/extensions and reference backends
general packed-ref maintenance, multi-ref transactions, reflog display/expiration, signing, hooks, normal message cleanup and full diagnostics
complete process-event tracing on macOS/Windows and long-running fuzz/crash campaigns
persistent pack cache, lookup performance and concurrent-maintenance invalidation/retry behavior
